building_identity: Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (NW), Purdue campus code CQNW; official GIS FID 647; historic database building record 358.
coordinate_contract: Repository approximate WGS84-to-campus transform; X east, Y north, Z up; meters. Not a surveyed CRS.

sources.role: authoritative footprint and campus GIS identifiers
sources.feature: FID 647; BLDG_ABBR=CQNW; BUILDING_N=Franklin Levering Cary Quadrangle (NW); NUM_LEVELS=5; CountOfFLO=5; Extrution=48; Shape_Area=1561.22; Shape_Length=255.98; ADDRESS=1008 W Stadium Avenue.
sources.measurement_method: 112 raw vertices converted using repository approximation; 0.5 m iterative vertex simplification for modeled shell; area/perimeter computed from projected ring. Model bounds (-432.46146455503776, 582.0829883582223, -364.65605279713407, 600.3406602091513); plan dimensions approximately 67.76 m long x 16.48 m wide; polygon area 903.1 m2.
sources.uncertainty: GIS Shape_Area/Shape_Length attributes do not agree with measurements of returned geometry; model uses returned polygon. Extrution units are undocumented and not used as a sole height basis.

sources.source_date: 2023 statewide orthophotography (service name); capture date not returned by export endpoint
sources.measurement_method: Visual comparison of roof plan and authoritative polygon overlay; not used to infer height or facade dimensions.
sources.uncertainty: Image is an orthorectified, resampled roof view. It supports a long east-west gabled mass and repeated roof interruptions but cannot prove facade openings, exact roof elevations, or entrance.

sources.provider: Purdue Geospatial Data Science Lab / Indiana Digital Forestry
sources.measurement_method: Transformed FID 647 WGS84 polygon to EPSG:2968 and sampled pixel centers strictly inside. Georeferencing uses tile origin (2,995,000 ftUS, 1,890,000 ftUS), 5 ft pixel size. Values are normalized surface height in feet; vegetation/edge mixed pixels remain possible.
sources.uncertainty: NDHM estimates roof/vegetation surface above terrain, not a surveyed wall, eave, or ridge height; edge pixels and canopy can affect samples.

sources.uncertainty: Catalog identifies Cary Quadrangle but not its specific unit. model_interpretations: GIS outline provides the model plan. The GIS Shape_Area/Shape_Length statistics conflict with the returned polygon; source polygon geometry is used.
Current aerial supports a long east-west roof plan with three large repeated interruptions visible on the two long roof slopes. Their simplified modeled form and count remain aerial interpretation.
GIS records five levels but does not document the counting convention. Four window rows plus a raised stone base are modeled; the relation of five levels to basement/attic remains uncertain.
Model ridge is 14.9 m, an estimate selected within the NDHM p10-p90 roof-surface range (11.95-15.87 m); no surveyed eave/ridge height exists in the consulted sources.

Brick/stone palette, repeated sash windows, stone courses and pointed-arch entry are Cary-period context, not verified details specific to CQNW. The entrance is placed on the courtyard-facing south long side based on building arrangement; exact entrance location is unverified.

A building-specific Office of the Architect archive folder (Cary Halls Northwest and West, 1937-1939) was found. It is not digitized here; its folder groups NW with West and the catalog does not expose a drawing, so it cannot validate facade or entrance geometry.
